name: GalaxyCon Oklahoma City
blurb: A three-day Oklahoma City festival of fandom from GalaxyCon, with celebrities, voice actors, comic creators, wrestlers and cosplay guests.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'GALAXYCON OKLAHOMA CITY ... May 28-30, 2027'; corroborated by galaxycon.com/pages/live-events: 'GalaxyCon Oklahoma City Oklahoma City Convention Center May 28-30, 2027 galaxyconoklahomacity.com'

notes: A dedicated page exists at galaxycon.com/pages/galaxycon-oklahoma-city (unlike what the discovery note assumed); id kept as given. The guests page's 'Guest Page 2' link (…-guests-page-2) 404s, so page 1's 43 candidates are the whole list. #34 is a second, bare 'Nolan North' card (no attendance text) duplicating #1's fully-confirmed one and is not double-picked. #31-32 (JSA, Agents of Slabs) are Authentication vendor services, excluded. Known for is left blank throughout (no bio text on any card). Cover uses the Oklahoma City wordmark logo; the homepage's other images are the shared 11-city promo, a generic galaxy background, decorative cosplay-cutout props, and a ticket-sale banner. Verify-05 recheck (2026-10-05): the guest grid sits under its own 'Coming Soon' section header, and a fresh extraction shows 35 of the 39 original picks (Jim Starlin, Dan Jurgens, Paul Bettany, Timothy Zahn and the rest) carry 2026-dated image filenames and match the independently-reported May 2026 Oklahoma City lineup that already ran; trimmed the picks to just the 4 with 2027-dated filenames (Ross Marquand, Nolan North, Erica Schroeder, Adam McArthur), who are independently confirmed touring GalaxyCon's 2027 Richmond/Oklahoma City/Nashville dates together. The other 35 are dropped as stale 2026 holdovers, not re-announced for 2027.
